paite: Judah kumpipa, Ammon tapa Josiah dam lai a, Kushi tapa, Gedaliah tapa, Amariah tapa, Hezekiah tapa, Zephaniah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung.
english: Yahweh’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.

paite: "Leitung a thil om tengteng ka hihbei sipsip ding," TOUPA'N achi.
heading: TOUPA Vaihawmna Ni
english: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.

paite: "Mihing leh sa ka hihbei ding; van a tungleng vasate, tuipi a ngasate, giloute toh kipalpuknate ka hihbei ding; leitung a pan mihing ka satkhe ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.

paite: "Judah tung leh Jerusalem a tengte tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a; hiai mun a kipan in Baal omlaite leh milim biak ching siampute min ka satkhe ding;
english: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,

paite: Intung a van aksihon bia; TOUPA kiang a kun a kichiam khin napi a, Milkom mai a kichiamte;
english: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by Yahweh and also swear by Malcam,

paite: TOUPA zuihna a kipan kilehheite leh TOUPA zong lou a, amah kanloute ka satkhe ding hi.”
english: those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN ma ah dai sipsip in, TOUPA ni lah anaita ngal a; TOUPA'N lah kithoihna abawlkhol khin a, amisapte ahihsiangthou khinta hi.
english: Be silent at the presence of the Lord Yahweh, for the day of Yahweh is at hand. For Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.

paite: TOUPA kithoih ni in hichi ahi ding, heutute leh kumpipa tapate leh gamdang puan a kizem huchibang tengteng ka gawt ding hi.
english: It will happen in the day of Yahweh’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.

paite: Huai ni chiang in, phual kan a tawmte, hiamgamna leh khemna a apu uh inn hihdimte, ka gawt ding hi.
english: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in," TOUPA'N achi, Ngasa Kongpi a pan kah thawmging a-om dia, Kongpi Nihna a pan mauna leh mualte a kipan nakpitak a siatna husa a-om ding.
english: In that day, says Yahweh, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.

paite: Mau un, nou Maktes a tengte, na sumsin mite tengteng a-omta kei ua; dangka teh mite satkhiak ahita uhi.
english: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.

paite: Huai hun chiang in hichi ahi ding hi, khawnvak tawi in Jerusalem zong ding ka hi; mi uain dawn a tengden, alungtang ua, TOUPA'N thil hoih hi in thil gilou leng ahih sam kei ding chi mite ka gawt ding hi.
english: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “Yahweh will not do good, neither will he do evil.”

paite: Huchi in ahauhna uh gallak ahong hi dia, a-innte uh asegawp ding; innte alam ding ua, himahleh aluah kei ding uh; grephuante abawl ding ua, himahleh huai a uain adawn kei ding uhi.
english: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.

paite: TOUPA ni thupi anai a, anai a, akinoh mahmah, TOUPA ni in kah aw athupi ding a; mi thilhihtheitakte huai ah akap loloih ding uhi.
english: The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries there bitterly.

paite: Huai ni thangpaihna ni ahi, lungzinna leh dahna ni, mialna leh lungkiakna ni, meipi leh khomial bikbek ahi;
english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

paite: pengkul leh gallauna ni, khopi daikaih siatna, aning a insangte siat ni.
english: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.

paite: Huan mite tung ah dahna ka tun ding a, mittawte bang in avak ding uh, TOUPA tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak un; huchi in asisan uh leivui bang leh asa uh eklei bang in butkhiak in a-om ding hi.
english: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against Yahweh. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.

paite: TOUPA thangpaihna ni chiang in adangka uhiam adangka-eng uhiam in amaute atan thei kei ding; himahleh amullitna mei in gam pumpi akangbei ding a; hihbei a om ding ahih ziak in, beina mulkimhuai, gamsung a tengte tengteng tung ah a-om ding hi.
english: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.
